question: In the XXI phase of sale of electoral bonds can be only purchase from which of the following institution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**SBI**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Electoral bonds in India can be purchased from the State Bank of India (SBI).**
 
• Therefore, the correct option is **SBI**
 
• These bonds are a** financial instrument **for making donations to **political parties** and were introduced by the **Government of India in 2017.**
 
• These are available for purchase by any** Indian citizen or company from specified branches of the State Bank of India.**
